verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agentic-commerce product catalog API, so merchant-side controls over agent access are a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents only developer- and agent-facing search, lookup, MCP, CLI, pricing and affiliate features. Nothing shows merchants being able to rate-limit, allow or deny specific agents or agent platforms for catalog or checkout access.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can rate-limit, allow, or deny specific agents and agent platforms accessing my catalog and checkout
